title: Master of Dungeon: AI Aventure RPG Update - Gameplay Screen
author: Tigeline

comments.author: Tigeline
comments.body:
Hi guys,

Following our previous post ([previous post](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1jb6zdy/introduction_screen_from_our_text_rpg_adventure/)), we want to share another update – we’ve just prepared the first gameplay screen for Master of Dungeon: AI Adventure RPG. Now you can see what the gameplay looks like and how your hero starts exploring the game world.

We’d love to hear your thoughts, so please check out the gameplay screen and leave a comment. Your feedback will help us develop the app further to better meet your expectations :)

Join us on our Discord: [https://discord.gg/QB54WXdYgN](https://discord.gg/QB54WXdYgN)

replies.author: warlymain
replies.body: Let me know when it’s ready to play! Could be a lot of fun.

replies.author: Tigeline
replies.body: Sure! We'll let you know right away - drop by our Discord, where we post daily updates ;)
